name: CrossRoad Ragdoll
desc:
This game is currently in Beta [In Development]
Also This game inspired general ragdoll chaos.

Controls 
Press Shift - Run
Press R - Ragdoll
Press Ctrl - ShiftLock
Press M - Open Menu
Press K - Open Robux Shop
Press B - Open Emote

You can use /reset to fixed character
/votekick [Name] to votekick [I hope so]
/rejoin to rejoin in the same server

V 1.3.9
